description: This file defines utility functions for creating lazily loaded runtime modules, surfaces, named exports, and methods with caching mechanisms. It enables efficient asynchronous resource loading with support for stable references and method binding.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeSurface<TModule, TSurface>( createLazyRuntimeSurface
methods.description: Creates a cache for a dynamically imported module surface, returning a function that when called resolves to the cached surface.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeModule<TModule>( createLazyRuntimeModule
methods.description: Creates a lazy loader for a runtime module, caching the entire module object.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>( createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
methods.description: Creates a lazy loader for a specific named export from a module, caching the export.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethod<TSurface, TArgs extends unknown[], TResult>( createLazyRuntimeMethod
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded method from a loaded surface, supporting asynchronous invocation.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder<TSurface>(load: () => Promise<TSurface>) { createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder
methods.description: Returns a function to create lazily loaded methods from a loaded surface, simplifying repeated binding.
